4 اتنّ , (K,) inf. n. إِتْنَانٌ, (TA,) He, or it, was, or became, distant, or remote. (K.) ＝
-A2- اتنّهُ It (a disease) stunted him, (AZ, IAar, T, S, M, K,) namely, a child, or boy, (IAar, T, S, M, K,) so that he did not attain to the stature of his equals in age, (AZ, T,) or so that he did not attain to full growth. (IAar, T, S, M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
